headline: Malware Attack Shuts Down Operations at Thai AccessSolutions Plant
body: The operations of Minebea AccessSolutions, located in Thailand and previously known as Honda Lock Thai, have been severely impacted by a malware attack. This cyber incident has brought production lines to a standstill across multiple sites. Restoration efforts are actively being pursued, with a step-by-step recovery plan being put into action. As of now, no demands for ransom have been reported publicly by the company.
